verdict.rationale: Flutterwave documents a public API with an API reference, JSON responses, and a Postman collection, and offers SDKs. It exposes wide API-driven capabilities including transfers, subscriptions, FX, OTPs, and virtual accounts, plus an AI-friendly llms.txt and docs.md. missing for 10: a discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404), independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: build fully custom solutions using our APIs
